India to Enhance Vehicle Safety Ratings from October 2027

India's Bharat NCAP (BNCAP) program will implement its second phase, BNCAP 2.0, starting October 2027. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced that the scope of the vehicle assessment program will be expanded, and crash test regulations will be made stricter. This enhanced phase will involve assessing the entire vehicle safety chain. The new regulations aim to toughen car safety ratings in India.
